question: In what manner and sequence will the requested qualities be truthfully explained to the six-faced one?
premises: The six-faced one is directly commanded to listen.
The explanation is declared to proceed in truth.
The account is to be given face by face in proper order.
inference: The requested qualities will be disclosed systematically, truthfully, and in sequential order.
uncertainties: The precise referent of each face in this context is not specified within the verse.
plain_english: Listen, O six-faced one: I shall explain it truthfully, face by face, in due order.
